critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2146-2242 /super-admin/subscriptions/revenue — correctly excludes razorpay_pending rows from all totals via {"$or":[{kind:{$exists:false}},{kind:{$ne:'razorpay_pending'}}]}; MRR normalises each active plan into a monthly figure via 30/plan_days ratio (correct for annual/half_year mix); ARR = MRR*12; churn denom = active + cancelled_30d protects against div-by-zero. avg_lifetime_days safely try/excepts fromisoformat. Top-5 top_tenants lookup joins tenants collection excluding _id. Clean implementation.

server.py L2245-2279 /export.csv — uses csv.writer through io.StringIO (correct handling of embedded commas/quotes); replaces \n in notes to keep rows single-line; Response with correct media_type and Content-Disposition. Fetch limit 20000 is generous for a growing SaaS. Fine.

frontend/src/lib/api.js — 401 interceptor implementation is correct: skips /auth/me + /auth/login (avoids bootstrap loop), skips public routes (/, /login, /book/*, /review/*, /signup-salon), clears in-memory token AND localStorage['miracurl_token'], preserves URL via encodeURIComponent(path+search) — all clean. NOTE: interceptor only fires when an in-memory accessToken is set — because api.js does NOT hydrate accessToken from localStorage on page load, direct-URL loads after a token expiry rely on the /auth/me cookie probe (also correct — /auth/me is explicitly excluded so it won't loop). This is defensible but means the failing-request→redirect path only exercises after user has done at least one authed action in this tab session.

SuperAdmin.jsx L445+ RevenuePanel — Recharts responsive containers cause 'width(-1)' warnings when they mount inside hidden Tabs. Consider deferring chart render until tab activates, or set explicit width/height. Cosmetic only.

rca of the issue: User's re-flag of 'save not working' is NOT reproducible on preview in iter26 either — every save (settings branding, settings tax on/off, customer create/edit, staff create/edit, product create/edit) succeeds at both API level (backend pytest) and UI level (Playwright). The 401 interceptor added in iter25 does NOT interfere with successful (2xx) traffic — confirmed by observing that after successful branding save the URL remained /settings with no /login navigation. If the user still sees 'save not working' on production, the likely production-only causes remain: (a) expired session → 401 from GET/PUT → NOW the interceptor cleanly redirects to /login?next=/settings so the user should see a login screen, not a blank one (this is the iter26 fix for the iter25 'blank Settings' RCA); (b) a browser extension or corporate proxy stripping Authorization headers. Recommend asking the user to open devtools → Network tab → reproduce the save → share the request/response — if the server logs a 200 but the UI still says 'not working', the JS toast library is being suppressed.
